key.name: sync-interval
key.description: Minutes between checks of every folder. The inbox is also watched continuously when the server supports it.

key.name: notify-new-mail
key.description: Show a notification when new messages arrive in an inbox.

key.name: send-delay
key.description: Seconds a message waits before it is sent, so it can still be taken back.

key.name: conversations
key.description: Show replies together with the message they answer.

key.name: load-remote-images
key.description: Load remote images in HTML messages without asking. Senders can use them to know when you read a message.

key.name: image-senders
key.description: Addresses whose messages always load remote images.

key.name: work-offline
key.description: Do not connect to mail servers. Changes are sent when going back online.

key.name: cache-limit
key.description: Megabytes of message content kept on this computer for reading offline.

key.name: list-width
key.description: Width of the message list in pixels.

key.name: dark-messages
key.description: Show messages with dark colors when the desktop uses the dark style.

key.name: reading-pane
key.description: Where messages open: right, bottom or off.

key.name: focused-inbox
key.description: Split the inbox into Focused and Other.

key.name: focus-view
key.description: Which part of the inbox is shown.

key.name: notify-focused-only
key.description: Do not notify about messages sorted into Other.

key.name: saved-searches
key.description: Searches shown under Favorites, as name and query separated by a tab.

key.name: sort
key.description: How the message list is sorted.

key.name: sort-ascending
key.description: Sort the message list in ascending order.

key.name: filter
key.description: Which messages the list shows.

key.name: blocked-senders
key.description: Addresses or domains whose mail goes to Junk.

key.name: ignored-threads
key.description: Conversations whose new messages go to Trash.

key.name: junk-filter
key.description: Learn from the messages marked as spam and move new junk automatically.

key.name: read-receipts
key.description: Answer requests for read receipts: ask, always or never.

key.name: mark-read-delay
key.description: Seconds a message is shown before it is marked as read.

key.name: autosave-drafts
key.description: Save the message being written every two minutes.

key.name: spell-check
key.description: Underline misspelled words while writing.

key.name: crypto-preference
key.description: Use S/MIME or OpenPGP when an account has both.

key.name: list-height
key.description: Height of the message list when the reading pane is below.
